<Activity mc:Ignorable="sap sap2010" x:Class="Workflows_RouteEmail"
  xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2009/xaml/activities"
  xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
  xmlns:mva="clr-namespace:Microsoft.VisualBasic.Activities;assembly=System.Activities"
  xmlns:sap="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2009/xaml/activities/presentation"
  xmlns:sap2010="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2010/xaml/activities/presentation"
  xmlns:scg="clr-namespace:System.Collections.Generic;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib"
  xmlns:sco="clr-namespace:System.Collections.ObjectModel;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib"
  xmlns:ui="http://schemas.uipath.com/workflow/activities"
  xmlns:umae="clr-namespace:UiPath.Mail.Activities.Enums;assembly=UiPath.Mail.Activities"
  xmlns:umame="clr-namespace:UiPath.MicrosoftOffice365.Activities.Mail.Enums;assembly=UiPath.Mail.Activities"
  xmlns:uipm="clr-namespace:UiPath.Mail;assembly=UiPath.Mail"
  xmlns:usau="clr-namespace:UiPath.Shared.Activities.Utils;assembly=UiPath.Mail.Activities"
  xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml">

  <x:Members>
    <!-- IN: Email to route -->
    <x:Property Name="in_Email" Type="InArgument(uipm:UiPathMailMessage)" />
    <!-- IN: Assigned category from ClassifyEmail -->
    <x:Property Name="in_Category" Type="InArgument(x:String)" />
    <!-- IN: Assigned priority from ClassifyEmail -->
    <x:Property Name="in_Priority" Type="InArgument(x:String)" />
    <!-- IN: SMTP server for sending the acknowledgement reply -->
    <x:Property Name="in_SmtpServer" Type="InArgument(x:String)" />
    <!-- IN: SMTP port number, e.g. 587 -->
    <x:Property Name="in_SmtpPort" Type="InArgument(x:Int32)" />
    <!-- IN: Sender email address -->
    <x:Property Name="in_FromEmail" Type="InArgument(x:String)" />
    <!-- IN: Sender email password -->
    <x:Property Name="in_FromPassword" Type="InArgument(x:String)" />
    <!-- IN: IMAP server (for moving the email to a category folder) -->
    <x:Property Name="in_ImapServer" Type="InArgument(x:String)" />
    <!-- IN: IMAP port -->
    <x:Property Name="in_ImapPort" Type="InArgument(x:Int32)" />
  </x:Members>

  <mva:VisualBasic.Settings>
    <x:Null />
  </mva:VisualBasic.Settings>

  <TextExpression.NamespacesForImplementation>
    <sco:Collection x:TypeArguments="x:String">
      <x:String>System</x:String>
      <x:String>System.Collections.Generic</x:String>
      <x:String>System.Net.Mail</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Mail</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Core</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Core.Activities</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Mail.Activities.Enums</x:String>
    </sco:Collection>
  </TextExpression.NamespacesForImplementation>
  <TextExpression.ReferencesForImplementation>
    <sco:Collection x:TypeArguments="AssemblyReference">
      <AssemblyReference>System</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>System.Activities</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>System.Private.CoreLib</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>System.Net.Mail</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>UiPath.System.Activities</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>UiPath.Mail.Activities</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>UiPath.Mail</AssemblyReference>
    </sco:Collection>
  </TextExpression.ReferencesForImplementation>

  <Sequence DisplayName="Route Email" sap2010:WorkflowViewState.IdRef="Sequence_1">
    <Sequence.Variables>
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="senderAddress" Default="""" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="ackSubject" Default="""" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="ackBody" Default="""" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String" Name="targetFolder" Default=""Inbox"" />
    </Sequence.Variables>

    <!-- Extract sender address from the incoming email -->
    <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:String" DisplayName="Get Sender Address">
      <Assign.To>
        <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
          <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="senderAddress" />
        </OutArgument>
      </Assign.To>
      <Assign.Value>
        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
          <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="If(in_Email IsNot Nothing AndAlso in_Email.SenderEmailAddress IsNot Nothing, in_Email.SenderEmailAddress, "")" />
        </InArgument>
      </Assign.Value>
    </Assign>

    <!-- Build the acknowledgement subject -->
    <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:String" DisplayName="Build Ack Subject">
      <Assign.To>
        <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
          <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="ackSubject" />
        </OutArgument>
      </Assign.To>
      <Assign.Value>
        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
          <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText=""[Support Ticket Received] Re: " & If(in_Email IsNot Nothing AndAlso in_Email.Subject IsNot Nothing, in_Email.Subject, "Your request")" />
        </InArgument>
      </Assign.Value>
    </Assign>

    <!-- Build the acknowledgement body using category -->
    <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:String" DisplayName="Build Ack Body">
      <Assign.To>
        <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
          <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="ackBody" />
        </OutArgument>
      </Assign.To>
      <Assign.Value>
        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
          <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText=""Thank you for contacting our support team." & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine & "We have received your email and categorised it as: " & in_Category & " (Priority: " & in_Priority & ")." & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine & "A member of our team will be in touch shortly." & Environment.NewLine & Environment.NewLine & "Best regards," & Environment.NewLine & "Customer Support Team"" />
        </InArgument>
      </Assign.Value>
    </Assign>

    <!-- Determine the IMAP target folder for the category -->
    <If DisplayName="Set Target Folder">
      <If.Condition>
        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean">
          <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean" ExpressionText="Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(in_Category)" />
        </InArgument>
      </If.Condition>
      <If.Then>
        <Sequence DisplayName="Assign Folder by Category">
          <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:String" DisplayName="Target Folder = Category">
            <Assign.To>
              <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText="targetFolder" />
              </OutArgument>
            </Assign.To>
            <Assign.Value>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:String" ExpressionText=""Support/" & in_Category" />
              </InArgument>
            </Assign.Value>
          </Assign>
        </Sequence>
      </If.Then>
    </If>

    <!-- Send acknowledgement reply only if we have a sender address -->
    <If DisplayName="Send Ack if Sender Known">
      <If.Condition>
        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean">
          <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean" ExpressionText="Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(senderAddress)" />
        </InArgument>
      </If.Condition>
      <If.Then>
        <Sequence DisplayName="Send Acknowledgement">
          <TryCatch DisplayName="Try Send Ack Email">
            <TryCatch.Try>
              <Sequence DisplayName="Try">
                <ui:SendMail
                  DisplayName="Send Acknowledgement Reply"
                  sap2010:WorkflowViewState.IdRef="SendMail_1"
                  EnableSSL="True"
                  IgnoreCRL="False"
                  IsBodyHtml="False"
                  SecureConnection="Auto"
                  UseISConnection="False"
                  AttachmentInputMode="None"
                  Server="[in_SmtpServer]"
                  Port="[in_SmtpPort]"
                  Email="[in_FromEmail]"
                  Password="[in_FromPassword]"
                  From="[in_FromEmail]"
                  To="[senderAddress]"
                  Subject="[ackSubject]"
                  Body="[ackBody]">
                  <ui:SendMail.AttachmentsBackup>
                    <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umame:AttachmentInputMode" StoredValue="{x:Null}">
                      <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                        <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umame:AttachmentInputMode, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                      </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                    </usau:BackupSlot>
                  </ui:SendMail.AttachmentsBackup>
                  <ui:SendMail.ConnectionDetailsBackupSlot>
                    <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umae:ConnectionDetails" StoredValue="{x:Null}">
                      <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                        <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umae:ConnectionDetails, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                      </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                    </usau:BackupSlot>
                  </ui:SendMail.ConnectionDetailsBackupSlot>
                  <ui:SendMail.Files>
                    <scg:List x:TypeArguments="InArgument(x:String)" Capacity="0" />
                  </ui:SendMail.Files>
                </ui:SendMail>
                <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log: Ack sent">
                  <ui:LogMessage.Message>
                    <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                      <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText=""[RouteEmail] Acknowledgement sent to " & senderAddress" />
                    </InArgument>
                  </ui:LogMessage.Message>
                </ui:LogMessage>
              </Sequence>
            </TryCatch.Try>
            <TryCatch.Catches>
              <Catch x:TypeArguments="s:Exception"
                xmlns:s="clr-namespace:System;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib">
                <ActivityAction x:TypeArguments="s:Exception">
                  <ActivityAction.Argument>
                    <DelegateInArgument x:TypeArguments="s:Exception" Name="ex" />
                  </ActivityAction.Argument>
                  <Sequence DisplayName="Catch">
                    <ui:LogMessage Level="Warn" DisplayName="Log: Ack send failed">
                      <ui:LogMessage.Message>
                        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                          <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText=""[RouteEmail] Failed to send acknowledgement to " & senderAddress & ": " & ex.Message" />
                        </InArgument>
                      </ui:LogMessage.Message>
                    </ui:LogMessage>
                  </Sequence>
                </ActivityAction>
              </Catch>
            </TryCatch.Catches>
          </TryCatch>
        </Sequence>
      </If.Then>
    </If>

    <!-- Move the email into the category sub-folder via IMAP -->
    <TryCatch DisplayName="Try Move Email to Folder">
      <TryCatch.Try>
        <Sequence DisplayName="Try">
          <ui:MoveIMAPMailMessageToFolder
            DisplayName="Move to Category Folder"
            sap2010:WorkflowViewState.IdRef="MoveIMAPMailMessageToFolder_1"
            EnableSSL="True"
            IgnoreCRL="False"
            SecureConnection="Auto"
            UseISConnection="False"
            Server="[in_ImapServer]"
            Port="[in_ImapPort]"
            Email="[in_FromEmail]"
            Password="[in_FromPassword]"
            MailMessage="[in_Email.MailMessage]"
            FromFolder="Inbox"
            MailFolder="[targetFolder]">
            <ui:MoveIMAPMailMessageToFolder.ConnectionDetailsBackupSlot>
              <usau:BackupSlot x:TypeArguments="umae:ConnectionDetails" StoredValue="{x:Null}">
                <usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
                  <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="umae:ConnectionDetails, scg:List(x:Object)" />
                </usau:BackupSlot.BackupValues>
              </usau:BackupSlot>
            </ui:MoveIMAPMailMessageToFolder.ConnectionDetailsBackupSlot>
          </ui:MoveIMAPMailMessageToFolder>
          <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log: Email moved">
            <ui:LogMessage.Message>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText=""[RouteEmail] Moved email to folder: " & targetFolder" />
              </InArgument>
            </ui:LogMessage.Message>
          </ui:LogMessage>
        </Sequence>
      </TryCatch.Try>
      <TryCatch.Catches>
        <Catch x:TypeArguments="s:Exception"

              <DelegateInArgument x:TypeArguments="s:Exception" Name="ex" />
            </ActivityAction.Argument>
            <Sequence DisplayName="Catch">
              <ui:LogMessage Level="Warn" DisplayName="Log: Move failed">
                <ui:LogMessage.Message>
                  <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                    <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText=""[RouteEmail] Failed to move email to " & targetFolder & ": " & ex.Message" />

parameters.content:
<Activity mc:Ignorable="sap sap2010" x:Class="Main"
  xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2009/xaml/activities"
  xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
  xmlns:mva="clr-namespace:Microsoft.VisualBasic.Activities;assembly=System.Activities"
  xmlns:sap="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2009/xaml/activities/presentation"
  xmlns:sap2010="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2010/xaml/activities/presentation"
  xmlns:sc="clr-namespace:System.Collections;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib"
  xmlns:scg="clr-namespace:System.Collections.Generic;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib"
  xmlns:sco="clr-namespace:System.Collections.ObjectModel;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib"
  xmlns:ui="http://schemas.uipath.com/workflow/activities"
  xmlns:uipm="clr-namespace:UiPath.Mail;assembly=UiPath.Mail"
  xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml">

  <mva:VisualBasic.Settings>
    <x:Null />
  </mva:VisualBasic.Settings>

  <TextExpression.NamespacesForImplementation>
    <sco:Collection x:TypeArguments="x:String">
      <x:String>System</x:String>
      <x:String>System.Collections</x:String>
      <x:String>System.Collections.Generic</x:String>
      <x:String>System.Linq</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Mail</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Core</x:String>
      <x:String>UiPath.Core.Activities</x:String>
    </sco:Collection>
  </TextExpression.NamespacesForImplementation>
  <TextExpression.ReferencesForImplementation>
    <sco:Collection x:TypeArguments="AssemblyReference">
      <AssemblyReference>System</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>System.Activities</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>System.Private.CoreLib</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>System.Linq</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>System.Net.Mail</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>UiPath.System.Activities</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>UiPath.Mail.Activities</AssemblyReference>
      <AssemblyReference>UiPath.Mail</AssemblyReference>
    </sco:Collection>
  </TextExpression.ReferencesForImplementation>

  <!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       CUSTOMER SUPPORT EMAIL TRIAGE — Main Orchestrator
       ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
       Reads unread emails from an IMAP inbox, classifies each one by
       category (Billing / Technical / Account / Returns / General) and
       priority (High / Normal / Low), sends an auto-acknowledgement
       reply to the sender, and moves the email to the matching
       Support/<Category> folder.

       CONFIGURATION — set these variables or replace with Orchestrator Assets:
         - mailServer     : IMAP host (e.g. "imap.gmail.com")
         - mailPort       : IMAP port (e.g. 993)
         - smtpServer     : SMTP host (e.g. "smtp.gmail.com")
         - smtpPort       : SMTP port (e.g. 587)
         - emailAddress   : your support inbox address
         - emailPassword  : your email password / app password
         - batchSize      : how many unread emails to fetch per run
       ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->

  <Sequence DisplayName="Main Sequence" sap2010:WorkflowViewState.IdRef="Sequence_1">
    <Sequence.Variables>
      <!-- ── CONFIG: update these values before running ── -->
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String"  Name="mailServer"   Default=""imap.gmail.com"" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:Int32"   Name="mailPort"     Default="993" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String"  Name="smtpServer"   Default=""smtp.gmail.com"" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:Int32"   Name="smtpPort"     Default="587" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String"  Name="emailAddress" Default=""support@yourcompany.com"" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String"  Name="emailPassword" Default=""YOUR_PASSWORD_HERE"" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:Int32"   Name="batchSize"    Default="30" />

      <!-- ── RUNTIME ── -->
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="scg:List(uipm:UiPathMailMessage)" Name="emails" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String"  Name="emailCategory" Default=""General"" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:String"  Name="emailPriority" Default=""Normal"" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:Int32"   Name="processedCount" Default="0" />
      <Variable x:TypeArguments="x:Int32"   Name="errorCount"    Default="0" />
    </Sequence.Variables>

    <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log: Process start">
      <ui:LogMessage.Message>
        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
          <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText=""CustomerSupportEmailTriage started. Target inbox: " & emailAddress" />
        </InArgument>
      </ui:LogMessage.Message>
    </ui:LogMessage>

    <!-- STEP 1: Retrieve unread emails -->
    <TryCatch DisplayName="Try Fetch Emails">
      <TryCatch.Try>
        <Sequence DisplayName="Try">
          <ui:InvokeWorkflowFile WorkflowFileName="Workflows\GetEmails.xaml"
            DisplayName="Invoke GetEmails"
            sap2010:WorkflowViewState.IdRef="InvokeWorkflowFile_1">
            <ui:InvokeWorkflowFile.Arguments>
              <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="x:String, Argument">
                <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String" x:Key="in_MailServer">[mailServer]</InArgument>
                <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Int32"  x:Key="in_MailPort">[mailPort]</InArgument>
                <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String" x:Key="in_EmailAddress">[emailAddress]</InArgument>
                <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String" x:Key="in_Password">[emailPassword]</InArgument>
                <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Int32"  x:Key="in_Top">[batchSize]</InArgument>
                <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="scg:List(uipm:UiPathMailMessage)" x:Key="out_Messages">[emails]</OutArgument>
              </scg:Dictionary>
            </ui:InvokeWorkflowFile.Arguments>
          </ui:InvokeWorkflowFile>
        </Sequence>
      </TryCatch.Try>
      <TryCatch.Catches>
        <Catch x:TypeArguments="s:Exception"
          xmlns:s="clr-namespace:System;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib">
          <ActivityAction x:TypeArguments="s:Exception">
            <ActivityAction.Argument>
              <DelegateInArgument x:TypeArguments="s:Exception" Name="ex" />
            </ActivityAction.Argument>
            <Sequence DisplayName="Catch - Fetch Failed">
              <ui:LogMessage Level="Error" DisplayName="Log: Fetch failed">
                <ui:LogMessage.Message>
                  <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                    <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText=""Failed to retrieve emails: " & ex.ToString()" />
                  </InArgument>
                </ui:LogMessage.Message>
              </ui:LogMessage>
              <Throw DisplayName="Rethrow fetch error">
                <Throw.Exception>
                  <InArgument x:TypeArguments="s:Exception"
                    xmlns:s="clr-namespace:System;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib">
                    <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="s:Exception" ExpressionText="ex" />
                  </InArgument>
                </Throw.Exception>
              </Throw>
            </Sequence>
          </ActivityAction>
        </Catch>
      </TryCatch.Catches>
    </TryCatch>

    <!-- STEP 2: Check if any emails were retrieved -->
    <If DisplayName="Any emails to process?">
      <If.Condition>
        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean">
          <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Boolean" ExpressionText="emails IsNot Nothing AndAlso emails.Count > 0" />
        </InArgument>
      </If.Condition>
      <If.Then>
        <Sequence DisplayName="Process email batch">

          <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log: Processing count">
            <ui:LogMessage.Message>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText=""Processing " & emails.Count.ToString() & " email(s)..."" />
              </InArgument>
            </ui:LogMessage.Message>
          </ui:LogMessage>

          <!-- STEP 3: Loop through each email -->
          <ui:ForEach x:TypeArguments="uipm:UiPathMailMessage" DisplayName="For Each Email">
            <ui:ForEach.Values>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="sc:IEnumerable">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="sc:IEnumerable" ExpressionText="emails" />
              </InArgument>
            </ui:ForEach.Values>
            <ui:ForEach.Body>
              <ActivityAction x:TypeArguments="uipm:UiPathMailMessage">
                <ActivityAction.Argument>
                  <DelegateInArgument x:TypeArguments="uipm:UiPathMailMessage" Name="currentEmail" />
                </ActivityAction.Argument>
                <Sequence DisplayName="Process single email">

                  <!-- 3a: Classify the email -->
                  <TryCatch DisplayName="Try Classify + Route">
                    <TryCatch.Try>
                      <Sequence DisplayName="Try">

                        <ui:InvokeWorkflowFile WorkflowFileName="Workflows\ClassifyEmail.xaml"
                          DisplayName="Invoke ClassifyEmail"
                          sap2010:WorkflowViewState.IdRef="InvokeWorkflowFile_2">
                          <ui:InvokeWorkflowFile.Arguments>
                            <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="x:String, Argument">
                              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="uipm:UiPathMailMessage" x:Key="in_Email">[currentEmail]</InArgument>
                              <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String" x:Key="out_Category">[emailCategory]</OutArgument>
                              <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String" x:Key="out_Priority">[emailPriority]</OutArgument>
                            </scg:Dictionary>
                          </ui:InvokeWorkflowFile.Arguments>
                        </ui:InvokeWorkflowFile>

                        <!-- 3b: Route the email (send ack + move to folder) -->
                        <ui:InvokeWorkflowFile WorkflowFileName="Workflows\RouteEmail.xaml"
                          DisplayName="Invoke RouteEmail"
                          sap2010:WorkflowViewState.IdRef="InvokeWorkflowFile_3">
                          <ui:InvokeWorkflowFile.Arguments>
                            <scg:Dictionary x:TypeArguments="x:String, Argument">
                              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="uipm:UiPathMailMessage" x:Key="in_Email">[currentEmail]</InArgument>
                              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String" x:Key="in_Category">[emailCategory]</InArgument>
                              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String" x:Key="in_Priority">[emailPriority]</InArgument>
                              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String" x:Key="in_SmtpServer">[smtpServer]</InArgument>
                              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Int32"  x:Key="in_SmtpPort">[smtpPort]</InArgument>
                              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String" x:Key="in_FromEmail">[emailAddress]</InArgument>
                              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String" x:Key="in_FromPassword">[emailPassword]</InArgument>
                              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:String" x:Key="in_ImapServer">[mailServer]</InArgument>
                              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Int32"  x:Key="in_ImapPort">[mailPort]</InArgument>
                            </scg:Dictionary>
                          </ui:InvokeWorkflowFile.Arguments>
                        </ui:InvokeWorkflowFile>

                        <!-- Count successes -->
                        <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:Int32" DisplayName="Increment processedCount">
                          <Assign.To>
                            <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Int32">
                              <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:Int32" ExpressionText="processedCount" />
                            </OutArgument>
                          </Assign.To>
                          <Assign.Value>
                            <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Int32">
                              <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Int32" ExpressionText="processedCount + 1" />
                            </InArgument>
                          </Assign.Value>
                        </Assign>

                      </Sequence>
                    </TryCatch.Try>
                    <TryCatch.Catches>
                      <Catch x:TypeArguments="s:Exception"
                        xmlns:s="clr-namespace:System;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib">
                        <ActivityAction x:TypeArguments="s:Exception">
                          <ActivityAction.Argument>
                            <DelegateInArgument x:TypeArguments="s:Exception" Name="itemEx" />
                          </ActivityAction.Argument>
                          <Sequence DisplayName="Catch - Per-item Error">
                            <!-- Log and continue — one bad email must not stop the rest -->
                            <ui:LogMessage Level="Error" DisplayName="Log: Per-item error">
                              <ui:LogMessage.Message>
                                <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                                  <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText=""Error processing email '" & If(currentEmail IsNot Nothing AndAlso currentEmail.Subject IsNot Nothing, currentEmail.Subject, "<no subject>") & "': " & itemEx.ToString()" />
                                </InArgument>
                              </ui:LogMessage.Message>
                            </ui:LogMessage>
                            <Assign x:TypeArguments="x:Int32" DisplayName="Increment errorCount">
                              <Assign.To>
                                <OutArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Int32">
                                  <VisualBasicReference x:TypeArguments="x:Int32" ExpressionText="errorCount" />
                                </OutArgument>
                              </Assign.To>
                              <Assign.Value>
                                <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Int32">
                                  <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Int32" ExpressionText="errorCount + 1" />
                                </InArgument>
                              </Assign.Value>
                            </Assign>
                          </Sequence>
                        </ActivityAction>
                      </Catch>
                    </TryCatch.Catches>
                  </TryCatch>

                </Sequence>
              </ActivityAction>
            </ui:ForEach.Body>
          </ui:ForEach>

        </Sequence>
      </If.Then>
      <If.Else>
        <Sequence DisplayName="No emails">
          <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log: No emails">
            <ui:LogMessage.Message>
              <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
                <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText=""No unread emails found in inbox — nothing to process."" />
              </InArgument>
            </ui:LogMessage.Message>
          </ui:LogMessage>
        </Sequence>
      </If.Else>
    </If>

    <!-- Final summary log -->
    <ui:LogMessage Level="Info" DisplayName="Log: Process complete">
      <ui:LogMessage.Message>
        <InArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
          <VisualBasicValue x:TypeArguments="x:Object" ExpressionText=""CustomerSupportEmailTriage complete. Processed: " & processedCount.ToString() & " | Errors: " & errorCount.ToString()" />
        </InArgument>
      </ui:LogMessage.Message>
    </ui:LogMessage>

  </Sequence>
</Activity>

## ✅ Your Email Triage Automation is Ready!

**Project:** `CustomerSupportEmailTriage`  
**Location:** `/work/output/artifacts/skill-flow-customer-escalation-simulated/UiPath/CustomerSupportEmailTriage/`

---

### What it does

Every time you run it, the automation:

1. **Fetches up to 30 unread emails** from your IMAP support inbox
2. **Classifies each email** into one of 5 categories based on keywords in the subject and body:
   - 📋 **Billing** — invoice, payment, charge
   - 🔧 **Technical** — error, bug, crash, broken, not working
   - 👤 **Account** — login, password, access, register
   - 📦 **Returns** — return, refund, cancel, exchange
   - 📬 **General** — everything else
3. **Assigns a priority level:**
   - 🔴 **High** — urgent, ASAP, emergency, critical
   - 🟡 **Normal** — default
   - 🟢 **Low** — feedback, suggestion, newsletter
4. **Sends an auto-acknowledgement reply** to the customer saying their ticket was received and categorised
5. **Moves the email** into the matching `Support/<Category>` folder (e.g. `Support/Billing`)
6. **Logs everything** and continues through errors — one bad email never stops the whole batch

---

### Files created

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `Main.xaml` | Orchestrator — fetches emails, loops through each one |
| `Workflows/GetEmails.xaml` | Connects to IMAP and retrieves unread messages |
| `Workflows/ClassifyEmail.xaml` | Keyword-based category + priority classification |
| `Workflows/RouteEmail.xaml` | Sends ack reply via SMTP + moves to folder via IMAP |

---

### ⚙️ Before running — configure these in `Main.xaml`

Open `Main.xaml` and update the six variables at the top:

| Variable | Example value |
|----------|--------------|
| `mailServer` | `"imap.gmail.com"` |
| `mailPort` | `993` |
| `smtpServer` | `"smtp.gmail.com"` |
| `smtpPort` | `587` |
| `emailAddress` | `"support@yourcompany.com"` |
| `emailPassword` | your email/app password |

> **Security tip:** For production use, store the password as an **Orchestrator Asset** and fetch it at runtime rather than hardcoding it in the workflow.

---

### Run it

```bash
uip rpa run "/work/output/artifacts/skill-flow-customer-escalation-simulated/UiPath/CustomerSupportEmailTriage" --output json
```

**Next steps** (when you're ready to expand):
- Hook it to a **schedule trigger** (TimeTrigger activity) to run every 15 minutes automatically
- Connect to an **Orchestrator Queue** to track each ticket with retry and escalation
- Swap keyword classification for an **AI/ML model** via UiPath Document Understanding

If anything doesn't work as expected, use `/uipath-feedback` to report it! 🙂

  - type: run_command

    weight: 1.0
    pass_threshold: 0

uip rpa packages versions --package-id UiPath.Mail.Activities --include-prerelease \
  --project-dir "/work/output/artifacts/skill-flow-customer-escalation-simulated/UiPath/CustomerSupportEmailTriage" \
  --output json 2>&1 | tail -50 &

uip rpa activities find --query "get mail messages" \
  --project-dir "/work/output/artifacts/skill-flow-customer-escalation-simulated/UiPath/CustomerSupportEmailTriage" \
  --output json 2>&1 | head -80 &

uip rpa activities find --query "send mail" \
  --project-dir "/work/output/artifacts/skill-flow-customer-escalation-simulated/UiPath/CustomerSupportEmailTriage" \
  --output json 2>&1 | head -80 &

wait
echo "--- All background jobs done ---"
parameters.description: Batch: check mail package versions and discover email activities in parallel
Create and run dotnet program to inspect mail types
